breaking.change: The catalogue and shipped presets now contain only pixel (topdown variant), cartoon-2d, faceted-low-poly, toy-3d (paper variant), inked-comic-3d and neon-vector. Removed cinematic-realism (muted), painterly-3d (lush, luminous-layers, expressionist), minimal-geometric (layered-silhouette), low-resolution-3d (monochrome-dither), pixel-3d-hybrid and anime-cel-3d. Also removed pixel variants 8bit, monochrome, detailed, luminous and coarse; cartoon-2d variants watercolor, storybook and rubber-hose; toy-3d variants voxel, clay and diorama; inked-comic-3d variants bold-comic and heavy-ink. Their previews, authored art, art bibles and mood overrides are no longer shipped. The six base moods remain.
breaking.fix: Refresh the platform catalogue, preset and preview payload together. For cinematic-realism remove the project's look reference and use the engine's realistic defaults; never replace realism with a stylised preset. Films also default to no look. For another retired art direction choose a currently offered style deliberately, not as a visual equivalent. Remove retired variant fields. No aliases or fallback for removed presets.

breaking.change: Removed cartoon-2d-watercolor, cartoon-2d-storybook and cartoon-2d-rubber-hose downloadable packs. The realistic packs are independent of look presets; their removal was an incident corrected by the realistic VFX restoration.
breaking.fix: Use the restored realistic-starter bundled pack or cinematic-realism downloadable pack for realistic effects, independently of whether a game selects a look. For removed cartoon variants choose the current cartoon pack and review placement, timing and art.
